sections.Profile:
The "Twister" pinball machine by Sega, released in April 1996, is based on the popular disaster film of the same name. Designed by John Borg, this machine features unique elements such as a spinning disc with a magnet, a fan mounted on top that activates during certain modes, and a "Dorothy II" canister on the playfield. It includes two flippers, 13 standup targets, and five multiball modes. The game captures the chaotic nature of storm chasing with fast-paced gameplay and immersive sound effects, including memorable quotes from the movie.
